name: 95816 · Sacramento, CA
findings: ZIP 95816 (Sacramento) has 175 nonprofit organizations. 99 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 89 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95816 (Sacramento) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
